top_15.title: The Game at Carousel: A Horror Movie LitRPG
top_15.added_decision: Actual knowledge and what an enemy thinks you know can differ.

top_15.future_proof: Compare a warned observer who maintains the role with one who openly reacts.

top_15.title: Dungeon Reset
top_15.added_decision: One carrier can be exempt while the surrounding world refreshes.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: let a local reset spare one tagged carrier, creating construction and resource loops. Read reset scenes before choosing what is spared.
top_15.future_proof: Reset one room and inspect body, belongings and construction separately.

top_15.title: To Another World... with Land Mines!
top_15.added_decision: An offered benefit need not expose its real drawback.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: information about a power can be a purchasable resource separate from the power itself.
top_15.future_proof: A reliable guide reveals one concealed condition before a grant is chosen.

top_15.title: Fine Structure
top_15.added_decision: An old true measurement can become obsolete when the world changes.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: a discovery receipt stores the rule version under which it worked, and later trials can fail under a changed local law.
top_15.future_proof: Keep a successful trial receipt; show a later failure under a new rule version.

top_15.title: Godclads

top_15.future_proof: Two authorities conflict over one action; record winner and affected scope.

top_15.title: Pale Lights

top_15.future_proof: Keep the original bargain alongside a later change in patron mood.

top_15.title: I Can See Your Death
top_15.added_decision: Seeing a clear future and being able to alter it are different claims.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: a reading has separate certainty and intervention status; apparent inevitability stays an observer claim until tested.
top_15.future_proof: Show a precise reading with an untested intervention flag, then record the actual attempt.

top_15.title: The Oracle Paths
top_15.added_decision: Opponents can also act on predictions.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: preview quality depends on which other actors also possess and act on guidance, rather than assuming passive opponents.
top_15.future_proof: Revise a preview when another informed actor changes their intended action.

top_15.title: Losing Money to Be a Tycoon
top_15.added_decision: A deliberate bad plan can be defeated by helpful independent agents.

top_15.future_proof: Separate intended loss, staff interpretation, actual profit and the system payout.
